mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI index (inflation) signals rising inflation expectations, which compresses equity risk premia and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in inflationary periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 9.0%, it signals a worsening labor market, which triggers monetary policy easing and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 9.0%, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly industrial production (INDPRO) signals an imminent recession, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both decline from prior period
failure_condition: In periods where both GDPC1 and INDPRO decline, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 (index) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 90 occurs in more than 40% of instances where the 20-day forward returns are positive, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a rising CPI index (inflation) signals that the central bank is forced to maintain high rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPI rises (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE increases (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both decline from prior month
failure_condition: In periods where both INDPRO and HOUST decline, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 600 (thousands) signals a housing market downturn, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 600 occurs in more than 40% of instances where the 5-day forward returns are positive, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
